Overview.Name: Spurthika Kasireddy
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Chicken pan fried (120 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Egg bhurji (2–3 eggs) + cucumber slices
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable fry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) & vegetable curry
Evening_Snack (Optional): Option 2: Puffed rice (murmura) with onion and tomato
Meal_3 (Dinner - lighter): Option 1: Curd rice (~150 g) + egg omelette (2 eggs)
Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid non-veg on Saturday and follow vegetarian options.
Do not skip meals during school or busy days as it can increase cravings later.
For sweet cravings, have fruit first instead of bakery foods or chocolates.
Keep fried outside foods limited to occasional social events only.
Consistent routine and yoga will gradually improve body shape and confidence.
